STRPSSM.description: Additional Stress Points Data (STRPSSM). Defines additional stress point coordinates at the i-end and j-end of a section, used by the Section Manager stress-point data.

OPT_SAME_J.description: Same Additional Stress Points Data at i & j-end. When true, the j-end uses the same additional stress points as the i-end.

POINT_SIZE_1.description: Point Size 1. Number of additional stress points for data set 1 (i-end); should match the length of POINT1.

POINT_SIZE_2.description: Point Size 2. Number of additional stress points for data set 2 (j-end); should match the length of POINT2.

POINT1.description: Point Data 1. Additional stress points for data set 1 (i-end).

Y.description: PY. Y-coordinate of the additional stress point.

Z.description: PZ. Z-coordinate of the additional stress point.

POINT2.description: Point Data 2. Additional stress points for data set 2 (j-end).

Y.description: PY. Y-coordinate of the additional stress point.

Z.description: PZ. Z-coordinate of the additional stress point.
